english.note: Use this when discussing something together in order to reach a decision or make arrangements.
Use this when the parties discuss and decide something together rather than when one person simply asks for advice.

examples.english: I want to discuss moving house with you.
examples.traditional: 我想同你商量下搬屋嘅事。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 soeng1 loeng4 haa5 bun1 uk1 ge3 si6

examples.english: Let’s consult each other about this matter first.
